[[Ennsa Stoneweaver]] is an [[Elemental]] [[boss]] that encountered during the [[Altrumm Ruins]] [[challenge mission]]. She spawns in the southwest corner.

== Notes ==
* The easiest way to [[capture]] this boss' [[Elite Skill]] is to start the mission, go to her spawning point, and wait until the timer reaches 8:30 minutes.
